conventions.units: hours and per-hour unless the key ends in _s (seconds)
conventions.legacy_repair: c = 0 with s = T_a = null (manual-only, mttrHours = T_m)

Identity pi_U = 1/(1 + lambda*E_R) holds to 0.0e+00. Double-precision (numpy) recomputation of these values agrees to 1.3e-16 relative.

cases.formula: U_perfect = prod U_i, U_i = lambda_i*T_i/(1+lambda_i*T_i); nu_i = lambda_i/(1+lambda_i*T_i); penalty_switch_failure = sum nu_i*(1-p_sw)*T_sf; penalty_micro_outage = sum nu_i*p_sw*t_sw_s/3600; U_approx = U_perfect + penalty_switch_failure + penalty_micro_outage
cases.notes: §12 first-order formula (tolerance 1e-6 as the spec marks it first-order). Added term / (1 - U_perfect) = 0.000133; U_perfect = 2.377e-05 < 0.01, so no first-order flag. Pure arithmetic (no linear solve).

cases.formula: CTMC §13 (v1 standby chain, SW_j cleared at 1/T_sf): A = sum_(j<=n-1) pi_j; nu = up->down flux; U_sw = sum_(j<=n-2) pi_j*lambda*p_sw*t_sw_s/3600; mttf_from_new = mean first passage j=0 -> {n, SW_*}
cases.notes: States j = 0..2 (up iff j <= 1) and SW_j for j = 0..1 exactly as described (SW_(n-1) included); from j < n: (n-1-j)*f*lambda -> j+1, lambda*p_sw -> j+1, lambda*(1-p_sw) -> SW_j; j -> j-1 at min(j, crews)*mu; SW_j -> j+1 at 1/T_sf. U_sw = sum_(j<=n-2) pi_j*lambda*p_sw*t_sw_s/3600. Alternative reading without SW_(n-1) (no standby left, the last active failure goes straight to j = n at rate lambda): A = 0.999937814812512, nu = 5.47229649897394e-05, mttf_from_new = 18359.0909090909 (identical). Double-precision (numpy) recomputation of these values agrees to 8.5e-16 relative.

cases.formula: lambda_sh = p_sh/((1-p_sh)*D)
cases.notes: Steady-state sub-health probability converted to an entry rate (two-state U<->H balance: p_sh/(1-p_sh) = lambda_sh*D). m*lambda*D flag not applicable (no lambda, m given). Exact arithmetic.

cases.notes: Reduction check: with m = 1, c = 0, policy tolerate the §14 chain is the v1 degradedUnit (up -> degraded lambda_deg = lambda_sh, degraded -> up 1/D, up/degraded -> down lambda, down -> up 1/T_m; A_cap = pi_up + c_deg*pi_deg). Classic chain computed separately: A_tolerant = 0.99601593625498, A_perf = 0.994528605339716; max |difference| 0.0e+00. (phi = 0.5 < phi_min = 0.7 here, so A_threshold would equal A_strict = 0.993041274424453; not part of the expected keys.) Double-precision (numpy) recomputation of these values agrees to 4.5e-17 relative.

cases.formula: P_i = prod_(j<i)(1-s_j); E_T_s = sum P_i*t_i; share_i = P_i*t_i/E_T_s; p_manual = P_(first manual rung); auto_mean_s = sum_(auto) P_i*t_i; manual_mean_s = sum_(manual) P_i*t_i
cases.notes: §16 ladder (constant rung times, no scale law). `reach` and `share` are arrays over the rungs in order. manual_mean_s is the unconditional contribution sum_(manual rungs) P_i*t_i (so auto_mean_s + manual_mean_s = E_T_s); the conditional mean time given that a person is needed would be manual_mean_s/p_manual = 14400 s here. Exact arithmetic.

cases.formula: step0: A = A_Xo^3*A_Bo*A_Co^2 with lambda_o = lambda+lambda_sh, E_R_o = (lambda*T_m+lambda_sh*D)/(lambda+lambda_sh), A = 1/(1+lambda_o*E_R_o); steps 1-3: A = A_G1*A_B*(1-U_G2); X -> §14 chain -> (A, nu) under the measure in force -> lambda_eq = nu/A, MTTR_eq = (1-A)/nu; G1 = §11 chain(n=3, k=2, lambda_eq, repair, crews=inf, p_sw=1) with repair = (c=0, T_m=MTTR_eq) at step 1 and the configured (c, s, T_a, T_m) at steps 2-3; G2 = §12 first order; switchover_penalty = A_step3(p_sw=1, t_sw=0) - A_step3; gain = A_step3 - A_step0

inputs.tree: series[G1 = kofn(n=3, k=2, X), B, G2 = parallel(C1, C2)]

cases.notes: Modelling conventions used (all intermediates in golden-v2-report.md): G1 crews unlimited (not configured; v1 k-of-n default); G1 has no switchover (p_sw = 1). Step 1: G1 = §11 chain with the equivalent two-state unit (lambda_eq = nu/A, c = 0, T_m = MTTR_eq) from X's §14 chain (c = 0, strict). Steps 2-3: G1 = §11 chain with lambda_eq from X's §14 chain (strict / threshold) and the CONFIGURED dual repair (c = 0.9, s = 0.95, T_a = 0.1, T_m = 6); the alternative 'equivalent two-state (lambda_eq, MTTR_eq)' reading gives A_step2 = A_step3 = 0.998732956561545 (difference -1.382e-06). phi = 0.5 < phi_min = 0.7, so the threshold measure is strict and A_step3 = A_step2 exactly. Performability at step 3 (X measured by A_perf) = 0.998756241462806 (not an expected key). Tolerance 1e-6 because G2 is the §12 first-order formula. Double-precision (numpy) recomputation of these values agrees to 7.6e-17 relative.

cases.formula: npus = nodes*npus_per_node; l1_chips = nodes*l1_per_node; l2_chips = sub_planes*l2_per_subplane; l1_l2_links = l1_chips*links_per_l1; links_per_subplane = l1_l2_links/sub_planes; l2_ports_per_subplane = l2_per_subplane*l2_ports; transceiver_ends = l1_l2_links*transceivers_per_link
cases.notes: Integer counts; links_per_subplane equals l2_ports_per_subplane (every L1 chip of a sub-plane has one link to each of its 16 L2 chips, and each L2 chip has one port per node), which is the consistency check of the topology.
